usage: deskops add [-h]
                   {task,pill,ritual,board,atom,materialization,repository,inbox-note,faq-doc,step} ...

positional arguments:
  {task,pill,ritual,board,atom,materialization,repository,inbox-note,faq-doc,step}
    task                Create an actionable task bundle.
    pill                Create a pill artifact.
    ritual              Create a ritual artifact.
    board               Create a board artifact.
    atom                Create a atom artifact.
    materialization     Create a materialization artifact.
    repository          Create a local repository artifact doc; use 'deskops repo register' for canonical ecosystem registration.
    inbox-note          Create a inbox-note artifact.
    faq-doc             Create a faq-doc artifact.
    step                Create a step artifact.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Examples:
  deskops add task --root . --title "Fix thing" --goal "..." --scope "..." --validation "pytest"
  deskops add pill --root . --title "Guardrail: Keep layers clean" --what "..." --why "..."
